name: DIGIT

name: Bisa Health

This platform has the integration process to share the core data with other eServices.

OpenELIS is used at a national scale in a variety of settings, from small general hospital labs, all the way up to national reference labs, and all sizes in between.

name: Querido Diário
description: Querido Diário is an open source toolkit that allows the centralization and analysis of official data extracted from the journals published by cities. It also makes this data accessible to everyone through a platform search interface, data download options, and a public API.

name: Torkel Opsahl Academic EPublisher
description: TOAEP is the first open access academic international law publisher.

name: Lexsitus
description: Lexsitus is the most comprehensive online legal-information platform for international criminal law, supporting retrieval, analysis and learning work-processes.

name: TrueNAS
description: TrueNAS is the world's most deployed storage software with millions of users, including the majority of F500 companies, delivering resilient and fully-capable unified storage for even the most mission-critical data.

name: Open Health Stack
description: Open Health Stack provides building blocks for creating next-gen digital health apps. These open source components save time and make it easier to adopt modern healthcare standards, leading to secure, offline-capable, data-driven solutions for healthcare workers in low-resource settings.

name: Harmony
description: Harmony is an open-source, end-to end data integration and advanced analytics platform for integrating, harmonizing, analyzing, and visualizing any number of structured data sources from different sectors (e.g. health, education, agriculture, sustainable development, climate change adaptation), ranging from routinely collected individual level data to operational research and survey data.

name: OpenMRS
description: OpenMRS is a collaborative open-source Medical Record System project to develop software to support the delivery of health care in developing countries. OpenMRS is founded on the principles of openness and sharing of ideas, software and strategies for deployment and use.

name: RapidPro
description: Open Source platform that allows anyone to build interactive messaging systems using an easy visual interface

name: Mautic
description: Mautic is the world's first open source marketing automation product.

name: Dalgo
description: Dalgo is an open-source data platform for the social sector which enables organisations to learn from and represent their impact effectively by automating data flow and data management processes.

name: TYPO3
description: TYPO3 is a powerful, open-source CMS backed by a vibrant professional community and commercial ecosystem. Built for enterprise, it fulfills the security and service needs of a modern business, while its feature-rich core delivers across sectors, industries, and organizations.

name: Food Price Monitoring and Analysis Tool
description: The FPMA is a web-based platform developed to facilitate the monitoring, analysis, and dissemination of food price data. As of December 2024, the database includes over 2700 monthly domestic price series covering 130 countries and 87 international price series.

name: The Land Portal
description: A digital portal making land information open, accessible, and inclusive. As a global hub for land governance knowledge, we empower communities by unlocking hidden data and amplifying unheard voices.

name: Apache Fineract
description: Fineract provides a reliable, robust, and affordable solution for entrepreneurs, financial institutions, and service providers to offer financial services to the world’s 3 billion underbanked and unbanked. Fineract is the backend to the branded Mifos solution.

name: Consul Democracy
description: Consul Democracy is a complete citizen participation tool for an open, transparent, and democratic government. This tool is free, secure, open-source, and easy to use, reflecting public values at its core so that all governments can take the first steps toward digital citizen participation.

name: UNIDO Industrial Analytics Platform
description: UNIDO's IAP is a data-driven knowledge platform that advances evidence-based policy dialogue, fosters thought leadership and connects global communities to share knowledge and practice in the field of industrial development.

name: Mifos X
description: Core banking platform to deliver digital financial services such as savings & credit-led financial inclusion, wallet accounts, G2P payments & IIPS integration. It includes the platform & open APIs, web/mobile UI for staff, reporting plugin & client mobile banking & wallet apps.

name: Global Healthsites Mapping Project
description: healthsites.io is building a baseline of health facility data by making OpenStreetMap useful to the medical community and humanitarian sector.

name: Avni
description: Community service and data collection platform on any domain - Health, Education, Sanitation, Water, Waste, Agriculture, Social Security

name: FormSG
description: FormSG is a form builder tool that enables public officers to instantly create customisable forms with zero code or cost, to safely collect classified and sensitive data.

name: Agrontology
description: Agrontology is a description vocabulary defined in the Web Ontology Language (OWL) providing a set of domain-specific properties for agri-food concepts. It is used for instance in the AGROVOC thesaurus to express domain-specific relations between concepts.

name: Care
description: CARE is a transformative healthcare management system, centralizing patient and capacity management across hospitals. Empowering administrators and healthcare professionals with real-time data for better decision-making, CARE is reshaping healthcare delivery.

name: Simple
description: Free software to manage large-scale hypertension and diabetes control programs.

name: Sunbird RC
description: “Sunbird Registry and Credential” or simply “Sunbird RC” is an open source software to rapidly build and deploy next generation electronic registries and verifiable credentials including attestation and verification flows.

name: GNU Health
description: GNU Health is a free/libre ecosystem for Health practitioners, Hospitals and nationwide Health systems. The GNU Health project provides the tools for individuals, health professionals, institutions and governments to proactively assess and improve the underlying determinants of health, from the socioeconomic agents to the molecular basis of disease. From primary health care to precision medicine.

name: Drupal
description: Drupal is an open source content management system powering ambitious digital experiences across government, higher-ed, non-profit, and other sectors for more than 20 years.

name: Janssen Project
description: An enterprise identity and access management platform-- Janssen is a distribution of standards-based, developer friendly, components that are engineered to work together in any cloud.

name: CommCare
description: CommCare is the digital platform for impactful frontline work everywhere. The most widely-deployed and evidence-based platform for enabling Frontline Workers, CommCare empowers organizations to build their own digital solutions to better deliver services and collect data.

name: Open Terms Archive
description: Open Terms Archive publicly records every version of the terms of digital services to enable democratic oversight.

name: OpenRIMS
description: OpenRIMS is a web-based tool that helps NMRAs streamline and automate their regulatory workflow processes aligned with WHO GBT Modules to ensure that they have the most updated medicines and devices available and lists of registered pharmacies and approved clinical trials.

name: Wikipedia
description: Wikipedia is a free online encyclopedia, created and edited by volunteers around the world and hosted by the Wikimedia Foundation.

name: Mojaloop
description: Open source software for creating payment platforms that will help unbanked people access digital financial services.

name: SanteSuite
description: SanteSuite (SanteIMS & SanteMPI) is an essential suite of products for national digital health infrastructure components that leverages a unique identity to facilitate data consolidation, harmonization, sharing, and building health information exchanges (e.g., OpenHIE) to establish interoperability across multiple software solutions. SanteIMS - is an immunization management system and EIR platform that supports the management of any type and scale of vaccination program including pandemic response, such as COVID-19 vaccination. SanteMPI - Master Patient Index/Client Registry (MPI/CR) platform designed to overcome barriers to leveraging person-centered data as a catalyst for transforming health systems.

name: OpenFisca
description: OpenFisca is a Rules as Code engine: it enables collaboratively making laws and regulations computable over APIs for developers, datascientists and researchers. This allows building software to help citizens and businesses understand how laws apply to them, designing better rules and public policies, debating potential reforms, and scaling economic micro-simulation.

name: Tor Browser
description: Tor advances human rights and protects users' privacy on the internet by hiding the connection between their internet address and the services they use.

name: The Turing Way
description: The Turing Way is an open source, open collaboration and community-driven guide on data science. We involve an internal open science community in creating and sharing best practices for open, reproducible, ethical and collaborative data science.

name: OpenEWS
description: OpenEWS is the world's first open source early warning system dissemination platform.

name: AgriTech Observatory
description: The AgriTech Observatory is a virtual knowledge hub established by the FAO Regional Office for Europe and Central Asia, offering practitioners, policymakers, and researchers a comprehensive resource to explore, analyze, and monitor digital agriculture initiatives across region

name: Chamilo
description: Chamilo is an Open Source Learning Management System that vows to help improve the availability of quality education around the world. Its main focus is to be easy to use, as we believe this solves the most complicated part of providing education through a computers.

name: OpenG2P
description: OpenG2P is an open-source platform that enables governments and humanitarian organizations to deliver critical social benefits directly to those who need them. It facilitates the building of secure, inclusive registries and digital cash transfer systems for social protection.

name: Ozone
description: Ozone is a growing ecosystem of digital health apps (EMR, billing, pharmacy, lab, imaging, etc.) exchanging FHIR-based data to instantly build secure health information systems—with real-time analytics for actionable insights.

name: Accessible Medical Records via Integrated Technologies
description: AMRIT is an open-source platform enhancing primary healthcare by equipping frontline workers with digital tools for data-driven decisions and seamless EHR access through ABDM-compliant, interoperable systems.

name: CKAN
description: CKAN is an Open Source Data Management System to build Data Portals. Trusted by hundreds of portals across the world and supported by an active community, it focuses on extensibility and integration with other tools.

name: QField
description: Survey and digitize data in the field with seamless synchronization QField focuses on efficiently getting GIS fieldwork done and exchanging data between the field and the office in a comfortable and user-friendly way.

name: Kolibri
description: The offline-first platform for teaching and learning with technology without requiring the Internet.

name: Data Norge
description: Data.norge.no provides a comprehensive overview of datasets, concepts, APIs, information models, services, and events in the public sector, including protected data. It helps you discover, assess, and make use of data.

name: Pix
description: Pix is a free, open-source public service for assessing and certifying digital skills. With over 15M users in 43 countries, it empowers students and professionals to develop their digital competencies, promoting lifelong learning for all.

name: AccessMod
description: AccessMod is a free, open-source, standalone software to model physically accessibility to health services, to account for shortage of capacity in these services (human or equipment), to measure referral times and distances between health services, and to increase population coverage through scaling up analyses.

name: IATI Data
description: IATI Data is a dataset that describes international aid finances and results, ensuring transparency and collaboration. All data is published to the IATI Standard, under open licenses. Data is available from over 1700 publishers, covering 1 million activities and around 2/3 of ODA

name: farmOS
description: farmOS is a web-based application for farm management, planning, and record keeping.

name: Marine Spatial Planning - SAHAV
description: MSP-SAHAV is an open software used for planning sea spaces that can help visualize and communicate complex spatial information, supporting informed decision-making and the process of organizing and managing human activities in marine areas across space and time.

name: Statbus
description: Statbus is a web application for statistical offices, assisting and enabling them to build and maintain a business register that is the backbone for national accounts and economic statistics.

name: GAUL 2024
description: GAUL 2024 compiles the most recent information on sub-national administrative boundaries worldwide. It is a critical dataset to facilitate data integration and analysis, enabling the visualization of statistics, monitoring trends and informed policy development at various levels.

name: WSO2 Identity Server
description: WSO2 Identity Server is an open-source Identity and Access Management (IAM) solution supporting secure authentication, identity federation, and user management via open standards such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM 2.0, and FIDO2.

name: Global Human Settlement Layer
description: GHSL provides analysis ready, global, geospatial data reporting about the presence of population and human settlements.

name: Quantification Analytics Tool
description: QAT is a modular web-based country led forecasting and supply planning product designed to enable users to easily build and compare forecast, optimize commodity procurement and delivery schedules, monitory stock status of products and share data with stakeholders.

name: Hand-in-Hand Geospatial Platform
description: The Platform is a supporting tool for the Hand-in-Hand (HiH) Initiative to accelerate the SDGs, using advanced geo-spatial modeling and analytics to identify the biggest opportunities to raise the incomes and reduce the inequities and vulnerabilities of rural populations.

name: Pol.is
description: Polis is a real-time system for gathering, analyzing, and understanding what large groups of people think in their own words, enabled by advanced statistics and machine learning. Polis has been used all over the world by governments, academics, independent media, and citizens.

name: FAO Digital Services Portfolio
description: FAO Digital Services Portfolio offers access to useful data, information, maps, and statistics on food and agriculture to achieve food security. AgriMarketplace - gives farmers the opportunity to know the approximate prices of each product in the surrounding markets, as well as the routes to reach them. E-Nutrifood - provides users with information on farm production and conservation techniques, as well as on their value and nutritional value. Livestock - provides real-time information on the control of animal diseases and epidemics and gives advice on how to optimize livestock feed. Weather and Crop Calendar - offers reliable weather forecasts, combined with an alert system that allows users to adjust their schedule and production activities based on meteorological data.

name: MyChild HelpLine
description: The MyChild Helpline app connects children and caregivers to vital child protection and emergency services. Offering real-time support and resources, it ensures every child has access to the care and protection they deserve. #ChildProtection #MyChildHelpline

name: SYSPIN
description: SYSPIN is an open-sourced data specifically for text-to-speech application development in nine Indian languages, namely, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Kannada, Bhojpuri, Maithili, Magahi, and Chhattisgarhi

name: Rights Tracker
description: A freely available tool robustly tracking the human rights performance of countries.

name: Designsystemet
description: Designsystemet is a publicly maintained open-source design system, owned and coordinated by the Norwegian Digitalisation Agency. It helps create accessible, user-friendly digital services across the public and private sectors.

name: Creative Commons Legal Tools
description: CC legal tools enable the sharing and use of DPGs via standard, international open copyright licenses. CC stewards its open licenses and public domain tools to give every person and organization in the world a free, simple way to share their work in the commons.

name: Joomla CMS
description: Joomla is a free, open‑source content management system (CMS) for building and running websites and web applications. It includes robust access control, content workflows, multilingual support, an extensible API, and built‑in privacy and security tooling.

name: Sentinel-2 10m Land Use/Land Cover Time Series
description: Sentinel-2 10m Land Cover Time Series provides public access to global land use and land cover data of the world from 2017-2024 with 10 meter resolution.

name: Rahat
description: Rahat is a collection of open-source, blockchain-powered projects for cash and aid distribution and management. It enables the efficient and transparent coordination of resources and relief efforts. By leveraging token-based transfers, Rahat supports anticipatory cash and voucher

name: Govdirectory
description: A crowdsourced and fact-checked directory of official governmental online accounts and services. The easiest way to contact your government.

name: X-Road®
description: X-Road® is open-source software that provides unified and secure data exchange between organisations in a collaborative ecosystem.

name: Rafiki
description: Rafiki is an open source gateway that lets licensed Account Servicing Entities connect to the Interledger Network and send secure, atomic transfers via the Interledger Protocol and Open Payments APIs, enabling fast and reliable cross-network payment clearing.

name: La Suite Drive
description: Drive empowers teams to securely store, share, and collaborate on files while maintaining full control over their data through a user-friendly, open-source platform.

name: La Suite Meet
description: Powered by LiveKit, La Suite Meet is a video conference software that offers Zoom-level performance with high-quality video and audio. No installation required—simply join calls directly from your browser.

name: OpenCHS
description: OpenCHS is an open-source, multilingual helpline & case management platform that supports governments and NGOs to deliver 24/7 protection, counseling, and referral services, with AI-powered insights for child protection and social services.

name: Open Data Editor
description: Open Data Editor (ODE) is a free, open-source desktop app designed to help nonprofits, data journalists, activists, and public servants detect errors in their datasets. It is designed for people working with tabular data (Excel, Google Sheets, CSV) who don't know how to code.

name: PeerTube
description: PeerTube is a tool for hosting, managing, and sharing videos or live streams

name: Compar:IA
description: Compar:IA is a conversational AI arena where users can explore and compare over 30 different models. Its mission is to promote awareness of model pluralism, bias, and environmental impact, while simultaneously building one of the world’s largest non-english alignment datasets.

name: MapBiomas Brazil
description: MapBiomas is a collaborative initiative that serves as a crucial open data platform providing detailed annual maps of land-cover and land-use changes of biomes to support and advance sustainable management and conservation of natural resources in different countries.

name: Green Roads Toolkit
description: Collection of resources designed to guide the planning and preparation of future road project investments, this toolkit incorporates a comprehensive array of exemplary green roads case studies, which can be applied by practitioners to guide decisions towards aligning road sub-sector investments.

name: Wikidata
description: Wikidata is Wikimedia's open community-curated knowledge graph. It acts as central storage for the structured data of its Wikimedia sister projects, including Wikipedia, Wikivoyage, Wiktionary, Wikisource, and others.

name: Rural Environmental Registry Registration Module
description: The Rural Environmental Registry (RER) is a solution for managing declared geospatial environmental information on rural properties to serve as a database for control, monitoring, environmental and economic planning.

name: Ghost
description: A free, modern, open platform for independent publishing and journalism.

name: KoboToolbox
description: KoboToolbox is an open source platform for the collection, management, and visualization of data. As the most widely used primary data collection tool in the nonprofit sector, it is the tool of choice for over 32,000 social impact organizations worldwide.

name: GLOBALEAKS
description: GlobaLeaks is a free and open-source whistleblowing software enabling anyone to easily set up and maintain a secure reporting platform.

name: Penpot
description: Penpot is the first open-source design and prototyping platform that enables true collaboration between designers and developers. Built on web standards (SVG, CSS, HTML), it provides professional design tools without vendor lock-in, available as cloud service or self-hosted.

name: CodeCarbon
description: At CodeCarbon, we believe, as Niels Bohr said, that "Nothing exists until it is measured". So we found a way to estimate how much carbon we produce while running our code. We did this by creating a Python package that estimates your hardware electricity power consumption.

name: Biomass Prediction Model
description: The vertify Biomass Prediction Model uses multispectral satellite imagery to predict forest Above-Ground Biomass, providing accurate, verifiable carbon-stock data. It supports climate action, sustainable forest management, monitoring to detect land-use change and deforestation.

name: Software Heritage Archive
description: Software Heritage collects, saves, and shares all public software source code, making sure it is preserved for a long time and everyone can access it.

name: AgriOS

name: African Storybook
description: Provides open access to picture storybooks in the languages of Africa for children’s literacy, enjoyment and imagination.

name: National Carbon Credit Registry
description: The National Carbon Credit Registry is an open-source toolkit that helps countries securely issue, monitor, and trade carbon credits, ensuring data integrity.

name: OSHWA Open Source Hardware Certification Data
description: A directory of hardware certified to comply with the OSHWA-maintained definition of open hardware.

name: SimpleAudit
description: Lightweight AI safety auditing framework for red-teaming AI systems through adversarial probing. Supports multilingual testing across safety, healthcare, and RAG scenarios. Works with cloud APIs or fully local models.

name: Open Sustainable Technology
description: A directory and analysis of the open source ecosystem in the areas of climate change, sustainable energy, biodiversity and natural resources.

name: neotree
description: The Neotree is an open source platform for improving neonatal care in low-resource settings.

name: SMILE
description: SMILE is a Digital Public Health Platform to Strengthen National Health Supply Chain and Logistics Management

description: The CAD Trust is digital, decentralised public data infrastructure which helps harmonise and improve access to data on carbon credits issued by crediting programs, governments, and international mechanisms to support transparent accounting under the Paris Agreement.

description: compar:IA, the French government’s AI arena, continuously publishes three French-language datasets: conversations, reactions, and votes. They support LLM training, evaluation, and research in AI and social sciences, and are rare for languages other than English.

name: FAO Agricultural Stress Index System
description: The Agricultural Stress Index System (ASIS) monitors agricultural areas with a high likelihood of water stress/drought at global, regional and country level, using satellite technology.

name: Mastodon
description: Mastodon is a free and open-source software platform for decentralized social networking.

name: Trade Trust
description: TradeTrust is an open-source software that digitizes international trade documents, reducing paperwork, documentation costs, and the risks of fraud. TradeTrust enables industry to verify a document’s authenticity and create Electronic Transferable Records (ETRs).

name: Docs - Collaborative Text Editing
description: Docs is a collaborative text editor designed to address common challenges in knowledge building and sharing.

name: Element
description: Element is a sovereign, interoperable and secure communications platform built on the Matrix standard. It enables organisations to control and manage messaging, voice and video with end-to-end encryption across mobile and desktop environments.

name: FireForm
description: FireForm is an open-source tool that saves first responders hours of administrative overhead. By using local AI to extract data from a single voice memo, it automatically populates required incident forms—ensuring total data privacy and zero redundant paperwork.

name: SYNTH
description: SYNTH is the first open generalist synthetic dataset for training small reasoning models end-to-end, jointly released by Pleias and the AI Alliance. SYNTH includes 79,648,272 individual text samples, comprising over 41 billion words.

name: Eurosky Identity Platform
description: Sovereign, EU-hosted identity and data hosting for the AT Protocol: a Personal Data Server that holds each user's account and data, plus Portal, the account-creation and management interface. One account works across hundreds of apps and can move to any provider.
